# Prospect Road Community Fund

> A volunteer-run community fund in Manatee County, Florida. It pays for a land use attorney to ask the county to correct its Live Local Act eligibility finding for a proposed 642-unit project on Prospect Road, and has a long-term target of $2,000,000 to buy the land for a community park. All income and expenses are published.

## Pages
- [Home and pledge](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/): milestones, neighborhood totals, pledge form, FAQ
- [Transparency](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/transparency/): ledger, income statement, balance sheet, refund shares
- [Statistics](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/stats/): contributions by community, over time, by size and method, and spending
- [Updates](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/updates/): dated news from the volunteer team
- [Blog](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/blog/): stories, dispatches, videos and media from SMARTManatee
- [The Live Local Act](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/live-local-act/): plain-language explainer and why residents believe the site does not qualify
- [Park vision](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/park/): the plan for a community nature park and the $2M target
- [Privacy](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/privacy/): what is collected and who can see it

## Data
- [Public ledger JSON](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/api/ledger): de-identified totals, receipts and expenses
- [Full ledger CSV](https://prospectroadfund.netlify.app/api/ledger-csv): every public entry
